name: Ziba (Mephibosheth's servant)
title: The Treacherous Servant
summary: Ziba was a servant in Saul's household who was appointed by King David to manage Mephibosheth's estates. He is known for exploiting David's flight from Absalom for his own gain by slandering his master Mephibosheth, but was later exposed.

keyEvents.title: Ziba Informs David About Mephibosheth
keyEvents.description: David summoned Ziba, the servant from Saul's household, to ask if anyone remained of Saul's family whom he could show kindness to for Jonathan's sake.

keyEvents.title: Ziba Becomes Steward for Mephibosheth
keyEvents.description: David commanded Ziba and his sons and servants to farm the land for Mephibosheth and bring in the harvest for him, while Mephibosheth himself would eat at the king's table.

keyEvents.title: Ziba Meets David During the Flight from Absalom
keyEvents.description: When David fled from Absalom, Ziba met him with donkeys loaded with bread, raisin cakes, fruit, and wine. He claimed that Mephibosheth had remained in Jerusalem to regain Saul's kingdom.

keyEvents.title: David Gives Ziba Mephibosheth's Property
keyEvents.description: Based on Ziba's accusations against Mephibosheth, David gave all of Mephibosheth's property to Ziba. Ziba bowed and thanked the king.

keyEvents.title: Mephibosheth Explains Himself to David
keyEvents.description: When David returned, Mephibosheth explained that Ziba had deceived him and left him behind because he was lame. David decided that the property should be divided between Ziba and Mephibosheth.
